about.title: Ho aha Litharollo tsa Digital E Tsoelang Pele Likhoebo Pele
about.description:
Oklut Technologies ke khamphani ya ditharollo tsa thekenoloji e tsepamisitseng maikutlo ho thuseng dikgwebo ho fetola mehopolo hore e be boiphihlelo ba dijithale bo nang le morero. Re kopanya thekenoloji, boiqapelo, le kutloisiso ea khoebo ho fana ka litharollo tse entsoeng ho latela litlhoko tsa lefatše la sebele.

Ho tloha ho phetoho ea dijithale le ntshetsopele ea mananeo a ikhethileng ho isa ho cloud, AI, automation, le lits'ebeletso tsa thekenoloji tse laoloang, re thusa mekhatlo ho nolofatsa mokhoa o rarahaneng, ho ntlafatsa ts'ebetso, le ho theha boleng ba nako e telele ba dijithale.

Mokhoa oa rona o bonolo — utloisisa mathata, le ho rarolla mathata a khoebo, le ho rarolla bothata bona.
about.awardText: E fumanwa ka bokgabane ba ho fana ka thepa ho tepo le boenjineri ba thepa ya mehala.

digitalTransformation.row2P2: Re ntlafatsa lits'ebetso, li-database, le likarolo tsa kopanyo ha re ntse re boloka maemo le ts'ireletso.
digitalTransformation.row3P1: Amohela AWS, Azure, le GCP, aha lipeipi tsa data tsa sejoale-joale, 'me a kenye lisebelisoa tsa ho ithuta ka mochini ho khanna liqeto tse ikemetseng.
digitalTransformation.row3P2: Ho tloha ho phatlalatso ea liketsahalo tsa nako ea sebele ho ea ho li-dashboards tse kopaneng, phetoho e fetoha e ka lekanyetsoang le e tšoarellang.
digitalTransformation.row4P1: Hlophisa maeto a bareki ho pholletsa le tepo e arabelang, iOS, Android, le li-portal tsa ho itšebeletsa tse nang le lihokelo tsa motho ka mong.
digitalTransformation.row4P2: Boenjineri ba sethala, telemetry, le li-loops tse itirisang tsa maikutlo li etsa hore popontšo ea dijithale e tsoele pele.
digitalTransformation.pillarsSub: Li-levers tse shebaneng le sephetho tse netefatsang boetapele bo tsitsitseng ba dijithale.
digitalTransformation.pillar1Desc: Merero ea phetoho ea mekhahlelo e nang le mohlala oa linyeoe tsa khoebo, taolo ea meralo, le ho latedisa kotsi e kgolo.
digitalTransformation.pillar2Desc: AWS/Azure/GCP metheo e nang le maru a mangata, liphaephe tse itirisang, le kholiso ea tlhahlobo ea data ea khoebo.
digitalTransformation.pillar3Desc: Bohlale ba tšebetso ea boiketsetso, liakhente tsa AI tse nang le kelello, le telemetry e lebelloang ho ntlafatsa ts'ebetso ea letsatsi le letsatsi.

privacy.managingPreferencesDesc: O ka hlahloba kapa oa fetola hore na ke li-cookie life tseo u li lumellang ka nako efe kapa efe ho tsoa phanele ea khetho ea li-cookie.

section1.title: 1. Boitsebiso boo re bo bokellang
body: Re bokella lintlha tseo u fanang ka tsona ka kotloloho (joalo ka lebitso la hau le aterese ea lengolo-tsoibila ha u fana ka foromo ea ho ikopanya kapa ha u theha ak'haonte) le tlhaiso-leseling e bokeletsoeng ka bo eona ka li-cookies le mahlale a ts'oanang, joalo ka maqephe ao u a etetseng, mofuta oa sesebelisoa le sebaka seo u batlang ho lula ho sona.

section2.title: 2. Kamoo re Sebelisang Li-cookie
body: Li-cookie tsa bohlokoa li lula li le teng hobane sebaka sa marang-rang se ke ke sa sebetsa hantle ntle le tsona. Ba boloka nako le boemo ba netefatso mme ba hopola likhetho tsa hau tsa cookie.

Li-cookie tsa Analytics li re thusa ho utloisisa hore na baeti ba sebelisa sebaka sa marang-rang joang hore re se ntlafatse. Li-cookie tsa ho bapatsa li sebelisoa ho u bontša limpho le matšolo a bohlokoa. Likarolo tsena li lumelloa feela ka tumello ea hau 'me li ka fetoloa neng kapa neng ho tsoa phanele ea khetho ea li-cookie.

section3.title: 3. Motheo oa Molao (GDPR)
body: Re sebetsana le data ea hau ho latela melao e latelang: tumello ea hau (bakeng sa li-cookie tseo e seng tsa bohlokoa le papatso), ts'ebetso ea konteraka (bakeng sa lits'ebeletso tseo u li kopang), boitlamo ba molao, le lithahasello tse molaong moo litokelo tsa hau li sa li tloleng. O ka tlosa tumello ka nako efe kapa efe ntle le ho ama ho nepahala ha ts'ebetso e entsoeng pele o e tlohela.

section4.title: 4. Litokelo tsa Hao
body: Ho ipapisitse le sebaka sa hau, o kanna oa ba le tokelo ea ho fihlella, ho lokisa, ho hlakola, kapa ho thibela ts'ebetso ea data ea hau, ho hanana le ts'ebetso, le ho ts'oaroa ha data. U ka boela ua kenya tletlebo ho balaoli ba lehae la heno.

section5.title: 5. Ho Boloka Boitsebiso & Tšireletso

information-reporting-systems.tagline: Boitsebiso bo Nepahetseng. Ka Nako e Loketseng. Bakeng sa Liqeto Tse Molemo.
overview: Baetapele ba likhoebo le lihlopha tsa ts'ebetso ba itšetlehile ka boitsebiso bo nepahetseng ho etsa liqeto tse sebetsang hantle. Lits'ebetso tsa rona tsa Tlhahisoleseding le Litlaleho li thusa mekhatlo ho bokella, ho hlophisa, ho sekaseka le ho hlahisa tlhahisoleseling ea khoebo ka litsamaiso tse hlophisitsoeng tsa tlhaiso-leseling, sethala sa tlaleho, li-dashboard, le mokhoa oa ho fana ka tlaleho o ikemetseng.

Mekhatlo hangata e na le tlhaiso-leseling e ajoang ho pholletsa le lits'ebetso, li-spreadsheet, database, le litsamaiso tsa ts'ebetso. Sena se etsa hore ho be thata ho theha pono e ts'oanang ea ts'ebetso ea khoebo. Re thusa ho kopanya mehloli ea tlhahisoleseling tikolohong e hlophisitsoeng ea tlaleho e fanang ka tlhaiso-leseling e tšepahalang, e fumanehang, le e tsitsitseng ea khoebo.
transformation: Sistimi ea tlaleho ha ea lokela ho hlahisa linomoro feela. E lokela ho thusa basebelisi ho utloisisa ts'ebetso, ho tseba mathata, ho fumana menyetla, le ho etsa liqeto tse nang le tsebo.
Re rala tikoloho ea litlaleho ho latela tsela eo mokhatlo oa hau o sebetsang ka eona, re fana ka litsamaiso tse hlophisitsoeng tsa data ho isa liqetong tse etselitsoeng mekhahlelo eohle ea taolo.

processAutomation.pillar1Desc: Multi-step human-in-the-loop le dijithale workflows orchestrated ka automated routing le maemelo a phahameng.
processAutomation.pillar2Desc: Bots ea software e thehiloeng ho melao e sebelisang mokhoa o tloaelehileng oa ho kenya data, poelano, le mesebetsi e fapaneng ea kopo.
processAutomation.pillar3Desc: Baemeli ba Cognitive AI ba tolokang moelelo, ba akaretsa sengoloa se sa hlophisoang, le ho etsa liqeto tse ikemetseng.
processAutomation.pillar4Desc: Ts'ebetso ea merafo, ho lemoha botlolo, le Kaizen workflows e tsoelang pele ho fokotsa litšenyehelo tsa ts'ebetso.
processAutomation.ctaTitle: Na u se u itokiselitse ho iketsetsa tšebetso ea khoebo ea hau?
processAutomation.ctaSub: Ikopanye le litsebi tsa rona tsa meralo ea li-automation ho tseba menyetla e phahameng ea ROI le ho sebelisa mekhoa e bohlale ea digital workflows.

centreOfExcellence.description: Mokhatlo o bohareng oa litsebi tsa meralo ea maemo a holimo le litsebi tsa domain tse inehetseng ho beakanya mekhoa ea boenjineri, ho khanna boqapi, le ho potlakisa boikitlaetso ba dijithale.
coreCapabilities: Taolo e Molemo ka ho Fetisisa
centreOfExcellence.row1Title: Boenjineri ba Software bo Phahameng ka ho Fetisisa
centreOfExcellence.row1P1: Setsi sa Rōna sa Bokhabane se theha mekhoa e tloaelehileng ea meralo, tlhahlobo e matla ea boiketsetso, le mekhoa ea tlhahlobo ea khoutu e sa sebetseng hantle e potlakisang nako ea ho ea 'marakeng ha sekoloto sa tekheniki se fihla ho lefela.
centreOfExcellence.row1F1: Liphaephe tsa tokollo tsa CI/CD tse nang le litlhahlobo tsa metrics tsa DORA
centreOfExcellence.row1F2: Liboto tse thata tsa tlhahlobo ea meralo le taolo ea litšebeletso tse nyane
centreOfExcellence.row1F3: Ts'ireletso e sa khaotseng e kenyellelitsoe le ho patch ea ts'ireletso e ikemetseng
centreOfExcellence.row2P1: Re etsa liteko ka mefuta ea morao-rao ea ho ithuta ea mochini, liakhente tsa tloaelo tsa AI, le boits'oaro bo bohlale ba phallo ea mosebetsi ho aha lihlahisoa tsa likhoebo tsa moloko o latelang.
centreOfExcellence.row2F1: Khokahanyo ea tsebo ea Enterprise Generative AI & RAG
centreOfExcellence.row2F2: Autonomous AI agent workflows for business process automation
centreOfExcellence.row2F3: Mokhoa oa ho itloaetsa oa ho ithuta mochini le ho lokisa hantle
centreOfExcellence.row3P1: Re rala le ho laola maemo a tsitsitseng a maru a mangata a hahiloeng holim'a meralo ea ts'ireletso ea zero-trust, ho netefatsa hore data ea hau e lula e sirelelitsoe khahlano le litšokelo tsa lefats'e ka bophara.
centreOfExcellence.row3F1: AWS, Azure, & GCP meaho e mengata ea lisebelisoa tsa maru
centreOfExcellence.row3F2: phihlello ea marang-rang ea Zero-trust (ZTNA) le maano a IAM a thehiloeng ho karolo
centreOfExcellence.row3F3: Ho hlahloba tshireletso ya setshelo ka boiketsetso le taolo ya lekunutu
centreOfExcellence.pillarsTitle: Merero ea rona ea Bokhabane ba Botho
centreOfExcellence.pillarsSub: Libuka tsa ho bapala tsa ntlafatso tse hlophisitsoeng tse matlafatsang li-platform tsa bohlokoahali.
centreOfExcellence.pillar1Desc: Tlhokomelo e felletseng e netefatsang hore litharollo tsohle tsa likhoebo li hokahana le maemo a thata, ts'ireletso, le liprothocol.
centreOfExcellence.pillar2Title: Li- Accelerator tse ka sebelisoang hape le Laeborari ea Karolo
centreOfExcellence.pillar2Desc: Sistimi ea meralo ea thepa, lisebelisoa tse qalang tsa API, le litempele tsa microservice tsa backend tse fokotsang nako ea ntlafatso ea pele ka 40%.
centreOfExcellence.pillar3Title: Tlaleho e Tsoelang Pele ea Ts'ebetso
centreOfExcellence.pillar3Desc: Liphaephe tse tsoetseng pele tsa ts'ebetso ea nako ea nnete tse lekolang ho lieha ha ts'ebeliso, litšitiso tsa phallo, le ts'ebeliso ea lisebelisoa tsa maru.
centreOfExcellence.pillar4Desc: Mekhatlo e hlophisitsoeng ea ka hare le litifikeiti tse holisang litsebo tse tebileng tsa tekheniki ho pholletsa le cloud, DevOps, le AI e sebelisitsoeng.
centreOfExcellence.ctaTitle: Phahamisa Maemo a Hao a Boenjiniere
centreOfExcellence.ctaSub: Selekane le Setsi sa Bokhabane sa Oklut Tech ho aha meralo e tsitsitseng ea maru, ho iketsetsa tšebetso ea mosebetsi, le ho potlakisa phano ea lihlahisoa tsa dijithale.
centreOfExcellence.p1Desc: Theha puso ea meralo ea khoebo ka bophara, melaoana ea leano, le maemo a ho latela melao.
centreOfExcellence.p2Desc: Hlalosa meralo ea sejoale-joale ea litšupiso, mekotla ea theknoloji e netefalitsoeng, le lipaterone tsa litšebeletso tse nyane.
centreOfExcellence.p3Title: Thepa le Lilaebrari tse ka sebelisoang hape
centreOfExcellence.p3Desc: Potlakisa lebelo la ntshetsopele ka likarolo tse arolelanoang, litempele, lisebelisoa tsa ho qala, le litsamaiso tsa meralo.
centreOfExcellence.p4Desc: Koetliso e hlophisitsoeng, tlhabollo ea thekenoloji, le kholiso ea bokhoni ho phahamisa bokhoni ba boenjiniere ba sehlopha.
centreOfExcellence.p5Desc: R&D ho liakhente tsa AI, liphaephe tsa boiketsetso, le meralo ea moloko o latelang ho boloka moeli oa mmaraka.
centreOfExcellence.p6Desc: Metrics ea boenjiniere e tsamaisoang ke data (DORA), benchmarking ea SLA, le ntlafatso ea boleng bo tsoelang pele.

solutionEngineering.description: Nts'etsopele le ntlafatso ea lits'ebetso, sethala, phallo ea mosebetsi, le tharollo ea likhoebo ho sebetsana le litlhoko tse ikhethang tsa khoebo le ho fana ka ts'ebetso e lumellanang.
solutionEngineering.row1Title: Likarolo tsa Bespoke tse Hahiloeng bakeng sa Tsamaiso ea Hao ea Mosebetsi
solutionEngineering.row1P1: Software e tloaelehileng ea khoebo hangata e haelloa ke ho fihlela litlhoko tse khethehileng tsa khoebo. Sehlopha sa rona sa boenjiniere ba tloaelo se hlahisa li-module tsa ts'ebeliso ea bespoke, melao ea khoebo e tloaelehileng, le likeketso tse ikhethileng tse tsamaellanang le ts'ebetso ea hau.
solutionEngineering.row1P2: Ho tloha ho lintlafatso tsa CRM le ERP ho ea ho li-portal tse khethehileng tsa ts'ebetso, re theha likarolo tse lumellanang hantle le mekhoa ea tšebetso ea sehlopha sa hau.
solutionEngineering.row2P1: Hokela lisebelisoa tse fapaneng tsa software ho ecosystem e kopaneng ea dijithale. Re etsa li-API tsa tloaelo tsa REST le tsa GraphQL, li-webhook handles, le mela ea melaetsa ea khoebo ho netefatsa khokahanyo ea data ea nako ea 'nete lipolaneteng tsohle tsa hau.
solutionEngineering.row2P2: Hore na re kopanya lisebelisoa tsa SaaS tsa mokha oa boraro kapa ho holisa lipolanete tsa thepa, meralo ea rona e kopanyang e etelletsa pele botšepehi ba data, ts'ebetso le nako ea ho theoha ha data.
solutionEngineering.row3Title: Lintlafatso tsa UI/UX le Ntlafatso ea Ts'ebetso
solutionEngineering.row3P1: Phahamisa likhokahano tsa lefa ka boiphihlelo ba sejoale-joale, bo arabelang ba basebelisi bo etselitsoeng lebelo le ho hlaka. Re fetola li-frontends ka mekhoa ea meralo e hlakileng, ho lumellana le maemo, le mefuta e ntlafalitsoeng ea litšebelisano.
solutionEngineering.row3P2: Ka mokhoa o ts'oanang, lienjineri tsa rona tsa ts'ebetso li ntlafatsa lipotso tsa polokelo ea litaba, maano a ho boloka, le boholo ba liphutheloana tse ka pele ho fana ka linako tsa karabo hang hang ho lisebelisoa tsohle.
solutionEngineering.pillarsTitle: E entsoe ho latela Litlhaloso tsa Hao Hantle
solutionEngineering.pillarsSub: Mekhoa ea ho ikamahanya le maemo a khoebo e etselitsoeng ho hola ka mokhoa o sa tsitsang.
solutionEngineering.pillar1Title: Mekhoa e Tloaelehileng ea Mosebetsi le Katoloso
solutionEngineering.pillar1Desc: Mechini e hlophisitsoeng ea ts'ebeliso le mechini e ikemetseng ea mmuso e hlophisitsoeng ka kotloloho ho potoloha melao ea ts'ebetso ea hau ea kahare.
solutionEngineering.pillar2Desc: Marokho a bolokehileng, a netefalitsoeng a hokahanyang li-backend tsa beng, li-suites tsa ERP, liheke tsa ho lefa, le lits'ebeletso tsa maru.
solutionEngineering.pillar3Desc: Litokiso tse tebileng tsa meralo tse fetolang software ea khoebo ntle le ho roba litsela tsa ntlafatso kapa litumellano tsa tšehetso ea barekisi.
solutionEngineering.pillar4Desc: Potso e matla ea lipotso, ho felisa ho lutla ha memori, le ho ajoa ha CDN bakeng sa meroalo ea leqephe la bobeli.
solutionEngineering.ctaTitle: Na u se u itokiselitse ho Fetola Sethala sa Hao sa Khoebo?
solutionEngineering.ctaSub: Ikopanye le litsebi tsa rona tsa meralo ea litharollo ho rala le ho tsamaisa li-module tsa tloaelo, phallo ea mosebetsi, le likhokahano tse tsamaellanang le litlhoko tsa hau tsa khoebo.

digitalTransformation.description: Tsoelo-pele e felletseng ea mekhoa ea khoebo, meralo ea thekenoloji, le mehlala ea ts'ebetso ho tsamaisa bokhabane ba mokhatlo, katleho ea ts'ebetso, le kholo e tsitsitseng ea dijithale.
digitalTransformation.row1Title: Ho tloha Pono ho ea ho 'mapa oa litsela o ka Phethahatso
digitalTransformation.row1P1:
Re sebetsa mmoho le baetapele ba dikgwebo ho hlalosa leano la dijithale, dinyewe tsa kgwebo, le mebapa ya mebila e nang le tlholo e potlakileng le ho fokotsa kotsi ya ho bolaya.
.
digitalTransformation.row1P2: Maiteko a etelletsoeng pele, mefuta ea TCO, le li-KPI li netefatsa hore boiteko bo bong le bo bong ba ntlafatso ea theknoloji bo hokahana ka kotloloho le lekeno, katleho le sephetho sa khotsofalo ea bareki.
digitalTransformation.row2Title: Iketsetse Sejoale-joale Ntle le ho Senya Khoebo
digitalTransformation.row2P1: Khutlisa li-monoliths ho li-microservices, li-API, le mekhoa ea tlhaho ea maru e nang le li-cutovers tsa zero-downtime le netefatso e ikemetseng ea ho fokotsa maemo.
digitalTransformation.row2P2: Re ntlafatsa lits'ebetso, li-database, le likarolo tsa kopanyo ha re ntse re boloka maemo le maemo a ts'ireletso.
digitalTransformation.row3P1: Amohela AWS, Azure, le GCP, aha lipeipi tsa data tsa sejoale-joale, 'me a kenye lisebelisoa tsa ho ithuta ka mochini ho khanna liqeto tse ikemetseng.
digitalTransformation.row3P2: Ho tloha ho phatlalatso ea liketsahalo tsa nako ea sebele ho ea ho li-dashboard tse kopaneng, phetoho e ba e leka-lekaneng le e tšoarellang.
digitalTransformation.row4P1: Hlophisa maeto a bareki ho pholletsa le tepo e arabelang, iOS, Android, le li-portal tsa ho itšebeletsa tse nang le lihokelo tsa motho ka mong.
digitalTransformation.row4P2: Boenjineri ba sethala, telemetry, le li-loops tsa othomathike tsa maikutlo li etsa hore boqapi ba dijithale bo tsoele pele.
digitalTransformation.pillarsSub: Li-levers tse shebaneng le sephetho tse netefatsang boetapele bo tsitsitseng ba dijithale.
digitalTransformation.pillar1Desc: Merero ea phetoho ea mekhahlelo e nang le mohlala oa linyeoe tsa khoebo, taolo ea meralo, le ho latedisa kotsi e kgolo.
digitalTransformation.pillar2Desc: Metheo ea AWS/Azure/GCP e nang le maru a mangata, liphaephe tse itirisang, le kholiso ea tlhahlobo ea data ea khoebo.
digitalTransformation.pillar3Desc: Bohlale ba ts'ebetso ea boits'oaro, liakhente tsa AI tse nang le kelello, le telemetry ea ho bolela esale pele ho ntlafatsa ts'ebetso ea letsatsi le letsatsi.
digitalTransformation.pillar4Desc: Li-portal tsa dijithale tse fetolelang holimo haholo le likhokahano tse etselitsoeng motho ka mong tse etselitsoeng ho boloka basebelisi haholo.
digitalTransformation.ctaTitle: Na o itokiseditse ho Fetola Kgwebo ya Hao?
digitalTransformation.ctaSub: Selekane le Oklut Technologies bakeng sa phetoho ea dijithale e seng e le kotsing e hokahaneng le liphetho tse lekantsoeng tsa khoebo.

endToEndSolutions.description: Moralo o hlophisitsoeng, oa phepelo ea bophelo bohle o akaretsang litlhoko tsa khoebo, moralo oa meralo, boenjiniere, kopanyo, netefatso ea boleng, ho tsamaisoa ha maru, le ts'ebetso e laoloang.
endToEndSolutions.row1Title: Litlhoko tsa Boenjiniere le Moralo oa Tharollo
endToEndSolutions.row1P1: Lithupelo tse kopanetsoeng, 'mapa oa sebaka sa khoebo, le litlhaloso tsa meralo ea maru tse etselitsoeng ho felisa kotsi pele mola oa khoutu o ngoloa.
endToEndSolutions.row1P2: Re hlalosa mehlala ea data, mekhoa ea ts'ireletso, le lintlha tsa bohlokoa tsa scalability tse behang katleho ea nako e telele.
endToEndSolutions.row2Title: Ntlafatso e Felletseng ea Stack & Teko e Ikemetseng
endToEndSolutions.row2P1: Li-microservices tsa modular, li-API tse sireletsehileng tsa mofuta, le li-frontend tse arabelang li kopantsoe le yuniti e ikemetseng, ho kopanya, le lisebelisoa tsa ts'ireletso.
endToEndSolutions.row2P2: Liphaephe tse tsoelang pele tse kopanyang le GitHub Actions, Terraform, le li-automated security guardrails.
endToEndSolutions.row3P1: Sehlopha sa liletsa tsa maru a mangata ho AWS/Azure/GCP e nang le rollback ea othomathiki, li-cutovers tsa zero-downtime, le ponahalo ea nako ea nnete.
endToEndSolutions.row3P2: Re fana ka tlhokomelo e tšehelitsoeng ke SLA le tlhahlobo e tsoelang pele ea telemetry ho hlahisa sehlahisoa sa hau ntle le moroallo.
endToEndSolutions.row4Title: Puso e Kopanetsoeng le Tšehetso e Tsoelang Pele
endToEndSolutions.row4P1: Boikarabello ba ntlha e le 'ngoe ho pholletsa le pokello ea hau eohle ea dijithale - lebelo la lebelo le pepeneneng, tekanyetso e lebelletsoeng esale pele, le boqapi bo tsoelang pele.
endToEndSolutions.row4P2: Ho phatlalatsoa ha likarolo khafetsa le linako tsa ntlafatso li boloka khoebo ea hau e le ka pele ho tlholisano.
endToEndSolutions.pillarsSub: Karolo e 'ngoe le e 'ngoe e entsoe ka matla a khoebo.
endToEndSolutions.pillar1Desc: Ho sibolloa ha sebaka, limmapa tsa meralo, le ho hokahanya ba amehang ho felisa likotsi tsa ho bolaoa.
endToEndSolutions.pillar2Desc: Li-microservices tse tsitsitseng tsa maru-native, kopanyo ea API, le tlhahlobo e tsoelang pele ea QA.
endToEndSolutions.pillar3Desc: Ho latela melao ea ts'ireletso ea Zero-trust, liphatlalatso tse kentsoeng ka har'a setshelo, le lisebelisoa tse ikemetseng tsa maru.
endToEndSolutions.pillar4Desc: Tlhokomelo ea 24/7 SLA, telemetry ea bophelo bo botle, le boenjiniere bo tsoelang pele ba ho iphetola ha lintho.
endToEndSolutions.ctaTitle: Na U Hloka Molekane ea Feletseng oa Lifecycle?
endToEndSolutions.ctaSub: Re na le bophelo bo felletseng ba theknoloji e le hore sehlopha sa hau se tsebe ho tsepamisa maikutlo ho liphetho tsa mantlha tsa khoebo.
endToEndSolutions.ctaButton: Molekane bakeng sa Bophelo bo Feletseng

migrationServices.description: Phallo e bolokehileng, e hlophisitsoeng ea lits'ebetso tsa khale, datha, le meaho ho ea ho meaho ea sejoale-joale ea maru, e tsamaisanang le ntlafatso e tsoelang pele bakeng sa ts'ebetso e matlafalitsoeng le ts'ebetso.
migrationServices.row1P1: Ho falla ha mosebetsi o sa reroe ho AWS, Azure, le Google Cloud ka ho iphumanela, moralo oa maqhubu, le tšitiso ea khoebo.
migrationServices.row1P2: Re leka-lekanya ho hapa botjha, ho etsa replatform, le refactoring ho ntlafatsa kakaretso ya ditjeho tsa botho (TCO) le matjato.
migrationServices.row2P1: Katiso e itirisang ea bobolokelo, phetolelo ea schema, le liphaephe tsa ETL tsa boemo bo holimo tse netefalitsoeng ka 100% ea botšepehi ba data.
migrationServices.row2P2: Zero-downtime cutover rehearsal e netefatsa botsitso bo felletseng ba data le tsoelopele ea khoebo.
migrationServices.row3P1: Nchafatsa li-monoliths tsa lefa hore e be li-microservices tse scalable tse hlophisitsoeng ka Kubernetes (EKS, AKS, GKE) ka lipolane tsa IaC tse ikemetseng.
migrationServices.row3P2: Tlhaloso ea ts'ebetso ea ka mor'a ho falla le ho ntlafatsa litšenyehelo ho netefatsa hore ROI e teng hang-hang.
migrationServices.row4Title: Teko e Ikemetseng & Lits'ireletso tsa Rollback
migrationServices.row4P1: Li-cutover runbooks tse lekiloeng ka ntoa, li-automated regression suites, le mekhoa ea ho khutlisa hang-hang bakeng sa khotso e felletseng ea kelello.
migrationServices.row4P2: Telemetry ea bophelo bo botle ka mor'a ho falla le 24/7 hypercare e tiisa botsitso ba tlhahiso e se nang sekoli.
migrationServices.pillarsSub: Mehato e theoleloang kotsing e tšehelitsoe ke li-SLA tsa likhoebo.
migrationServices.pillar1Desc: Lintlafatso tsa Canary le khokahano ea mongolo o habeli oa database ho netefatsa phihlello e sa sitisoeng ke basebelisi.
migrationServices.pillar2Desc: Lipapiso tsa Checksum, tlhahlobo ea schema integrity, le poelano e ikemetseng ea ETL.
migrationServices.pillar3Desc: Melao-motheo e tiileng ea ho hlaphoheloa ha likoluoa le boithapollo ho thibela kotsi mokhahlelong o mong le o mong.
migrationServices.pillar4Desc: Litokelo tsa Cloud, maano a autoscaling, le li-dashboard tsa taolo ea litšenyehelo li kenyelelitsoe.
migrationServices.ctaTitle: Na u se u itokiselitse ho falla ka kholiseho e felletseng?
migrationServices.ctaSub: Selekane le Oklut Technologies bakeng sa maru a hlophisitsoeng, a se nang kotsi le ntlafatso ea data.
migrationServices.ctaButton: Rera Seboka sa Hao sa Phalliso

pilotPrototyping.eyebrow: Tiisetso e Potlakileng le Ho khoneha
pilotPrototyping.description: Nts'etsopele e potlakileng le netefatso ea tharollo ea thekenoloji ho lekola bokhoni ba tekheniki, boleng ba khoebo, litlhoko tsa ho kopanya, ts'ebetso, le scalability pele ho ts'ebetsong ka botlalo.
pilotPrototyping.row1Title: Ho tloha ho Khopolo ho ea ho Tsebo e Tiisitsoeng
pilotPrototyping.row1P1: Ho fetola mohopolo ho ba tharollo ea maemo a khoebo ho hloka netefatso e matla ea pele. Ts'ebeletso ea rona ea PoC & Pilot e lekola ts'ebetso ea theknoloji, liteko tsa khatello ea maikutlo, 'me e netefatsa ROI ea khoebo pele ho boitlamo bo boholo ba chelete.
pilotPrototyping.row1P2: Re theha li-MVP tsa boleng bo holimo le bakhanni ba li-sandbox ba tsepamisitseng maikutlo ba bonts'ang ho khoneha, ho lekanya ho lieha ha sistimi, le ho bokella netefatso e tobileng ea ba amehang pele ho nako.
pilotPrototyping.row1Cap: Prototyping e Potlakileng ea MVP & Litekanyetso tsa Tekheniki
pilotPrototyping.row2P1: Re aha li-wireframes tse sebetsanang, ho tobeha ho phalla ha basebelisi, le bopaki bo sebetsang ba maikutlo ka matsatsi, eseng likhoeli. Lekola litšebelisano tsa 'nete tsa basebelisi, ntlafatsa mekhoa ea UI/UX, 'me u bokelle maikutlo a sebetsang ho tsoa ho ba amehang.
pilotPrototyping.row2P2: Ka ho khutsufatsa lipono tsa maikutlo nakong ea nts'etsopele ea pele, sehlopha sa hau se fokotsa ts'ebetso hape 'me se fana ka lintlha tse hlakileng tsa tekheniki pele mekhahlelo ea kaho e matla haholo e qala.
pilotPrototyping.row2Cap: Potlako e Potlakileng le Li-Prototypes tsa UX tse tobehang
pilotPrototyping.row3P1: Utlolla mathata a tekheniki, meeli ea API, le mathata a ts'ebetso pele ho boitlamo bo felletseng ba chelete. Sehlopha sa rona sa boenjineri se lekola khatello ea maikutlo, lipeipi tsa data, le li-API tsa mokha oa boraro libakeng tse ka thoko tsa sandbox.
pilotPrototyping.row3P2: Phokotso ena e matla ea kotsi e netefatsa phumaneho e phahameng ea sistimi, ho latela ts'ireletso, le linako tsa nts'etsopele tse ka lebelloang ha o fetolela PoC ea hau tlhahisong ea khoebo.
pilotPrototyping.row3Cap: Kopano ea Lebokose la Lehlabathe & Teko ea Khatello ea Maikutlo
pilotPrototyping.row4Title: Qalo ea Pilot e Reriloeng & Tiisetso ea Nyeoe ea Khoebo
pilotPrototyping.row4P1: Kenya litokollo tse lebisitsoeng tsa mofofisi sebakeng se khethiloeng sa basebelisi kapa 'marakeng oa liteko. Latela metrics ea ts'ebetso, litlhahlobo tsa ho amoheloa ha basebelisi, le maikutlo a ts'ebetso ho lekanya boleng ba khoebo le ho theha khoebo e tšehelitsoeng ke data.
pilotPrototyping.row4P2: Ka leseli la lifofane tsa lefats'e, batšehetsi ba phahameng ba fumana metrics e hlakileng ea ROI ho lokafatsa phepelo e pharalletseng le matsete a maano a phetoho ea dijithale.
pilotPrototyping.row4Cap: Tsamaiso e Laolang le Telemetry ea Ts'ebetso
pilotPrototyping.pillarsTitle: Melao-motheo ea Rona ea Boenjineri ba Lifofane
pilotPrototyping.pillarsSub: Melao-motheo e tataisang e fetolang ho hloka kholiseho ea tekheniki hore e be katleho ea khoebo e lebelletsoeng esale pele.
pilotPrototyping.pillar1Desc: Fana ka li-prototype tse sebetsang ka potlako ho netefatsa litlhahiso tsa boleng pele ho nako ea bophelo.

aiRobotics.intro: Artificial Intelligence (AI) le Liroboto li fetola tsela eo likhoebo li sebetsang ka eona ka ho kopanya ho etsa liqeto ka bohlale le li-automation tse tsoetseng pele. AI e thusa mechini ho sekaseka datha, ho ithuta lipaterone, le ho etsa liqeto tse bohlale, athe liroboto li tlisa bokhoni bona lefatšeng la 'mele ho etsa mesebetsi ka lebelo, ho nepahala le ho tsitsa.
aiRobotics.section1Heading: E etselitsoe ho nolofatsa ts'ebetso e 'ngoe le e' ngoe
aiRobotics.section1Text: Litharollo tsa rona tsa AI le Liroboto li thusa mekhatlo ho tsamaisa tšebetso, ho fokotsa boikitlaetso ba matsoho, le ho ntlafatsa tlhahiso ho liindasteri tse fapaneng. Ho tloha ho li-automation le li-analytics tse lebelloang esale pele ho isa ho liroboto tse bohlale le litsamaiso tse bohlale, re fana ka mahlale a macha a ntlafatsang ts'ebetso, a tsamaisang kholo, le ho ts'ehetsa phetoho ea dijithale.
aiRobotics.section2Heading: Moo bohlale bo kopanang le ketso
aiRobotics.section2Text: Tšebelisano e 'ngoe le e' ngoe, liqeto le motsamao li tsamaisoa ke sistimi e le 'ngoe e hokahaneng - e fetolang data hore e be liphetho ka nako ea nnete.

informationReporting.section1Heading: Sistimi e le 'ngoe e bohareng bakeng sa metric e ngoe le e ngoe e bohlokoa
informationReporting.section1P1: Information & Reporting Systems ke litharollo tsa bohlokoa tsa khoebo tse nolofalletsang mekhatlo ho bokella, ho laola, le ho fetola lintlha ho ba leseli le utloahalang. Litsamaiso tsena li kopanya tlhahisoleseling ho tsoa mafapheng a mangata, ho netefatsa phihlello e nepahetseng, e tsitsitseng, le ea nako ea nnete ho data ea bohlokoa ea khoebo. Ka ho fana ka sethala se bohareng bakeng sa taolo ea tlhaiso-leseling, mekhatlo e ka ntlafatsa ponahalo ea ts'ebetso, ea nolofatsa ts'ebetso ea ts'ebetso, le ho ts'ehetsa ho etsa liqeto tsa maano maemong ohle a khoebo.
informationReporting.section1P2: Lisistimi tsena li sebelisa litlaleho tse itirisang, li-analytics, le li-dashboard ho sala morao tšebetso, ho beha leihlo lintlha tsa bohlokoa, le ho hlahisa litlaleho tsa nako ea nnete. Ka ho fokotsa boiteko ba matsoho le ho ntlafatsa ho nepahala ha data, likhoebo li ka etsa liqeto tse potlakileng le tse sebetsang haholoanyane.
informationReporting.section2Heading: E etselitsoe ponahalo, ho lumellana, le tekanyo
informationReporting.section2Text: Ka ponahalo e ntlafalitsoeng, ho latela melao, le tšebelisano-'moho, Lits'ebetso tsa Boitsebiso le Litlaleho li thusa mekhatlo ho ntlafatsa lits'ebetso, ho ntlafatsa tlhahiso, le ho tsamaisa kholo e tsitsitseng ea khoebo tikolohong ea tlholisano.

businessTransformation.sec1Heading: Mathata a ho Tsamaisa Khoebong e Hōlang
businessTransformation.sec1Subtext: Ha likhoebo li ntse li eketseha, litsamaiso tsa tikoloho ea mahlale li a hola. Se qalang e le litharollo tse tsepamisitsoeng bakeng sa mafapha ka bomong se ka fetoha marang-rang a ferekaneng a litsamaiso tse fapaneng.
businessTransformation.sec2Subtext: Ha lits'ebetso tsa khoebo, datha, le litsamaiso tsa ts'ebetso li iphetola ka boikemelo, phallo ea tlhahisoleseling e arohana. Ho utloisisa karohano ena ke mohato oa pele oa bohlokoa.
businessTransformation.sec3Subtext: Likhoebo li leba moahong oa pele o tsamaisoang ke ketsahalo, API moo data e phallang ka botšepehi ho li-platform tsa mantlha mme e fihla ho baetsi ba liqeto ka nako ea nnete.
businessTransformation.sec4Subtext: Ha lits'ebetso tsa khoebo li buisana ka mokhoa o sa tsitsang, data e khaotsa ho ba sehlahisoa sa tlaleho mme e fetoha mokhanni oa mantlha oa mahlale a ts'ebetso.
businessTransformation.sec5Subtext: Maikutlo a felletseng a likarolo tsa mantlha tsa thekenoloji tse bopang motheo oa khoebo oa sejoale-joale, o ka senyehang.
businessTransformation.sec6Subtext: Ho ntlafatsa meralo ea lits'ebetso le ho hokahanya lintlha tse arohaneng ho fana ka lintlafatso tse hlakileng tsa ts'ebetso ho pholletsa le mokhatlo.
businessTransformation.ctaHeading: O Itokiselitse ho Nchafatsa Tikoloho ea Hao ea Theknoloji?
businessTransformation.ctaDescription: Lekola hore na meralo ea sejoale-joale ea likopo, data e hokahantsoeng le thekenoloji ea scalable li ka thusa mekhatlo ho ntlafatsa katleho le ho itokisetsa kholo ea nako e tlang.
businessTransformation.sec1P1: Sebakeng se tloaelehileng sa khoebo, kholo hangata e hlahisa meloko e mengata ea software. Lichelete, phepelo ea thepa, litšebeletso tsa bareki, le ts'ebetso ea masimong hangata li sebetsa ho li-software tse fapaneng tse fumanoeng kapa tse hahiloeng ka linako tse fapaneng. Ho theosa le lilemo tsa ts'ebetso ea ts'ebetso, litsamaiso tsena li iketsetsa lifomate tsa tsona tsa data, li ntlafatsa li-cadences, le li-quirks tsa ho kopanya.

businessTransformation.sec1P3: Ho sebetsana le mathata ana ho hloka ho sheba maemo a thekenoloji eseng e le pokello ea theko ea software e ikhethileng, empa e le sethala sa khoebo se hokahaneng se etselitsoeng ho ts'ehetsa ts'ebetso ea maano.

businessTransformation.modernArchitectureTitle: Mohlala oa Kopo o Hoketsoeng oa Khoebo
businessTransformation.sec3P1: Moralo oa sejoale-joale oa ts'ebeliso o nka sebaka sa likhokahano tsa brittle point-to-point ka motheo o tsoileng matsoho, o arohaneng. Ka ho theha API e matla le lera la kopanyo, litsamaiso li sebelisana ka libaka tse laoloang, tse sireletsehileng ha li ntse li boloka boikemelo ba likarolo tsa khoebo ka bomong.
businessTransformation.sec3P2: Tsebo ea bohlokoa ea tekheniki ea phetoho ena ea meralo e kenyelletsa:

sec3List.text: Ho kopanya mohopolo oa mantlha oa khoebo hore e be lits'ebeletso tse ka senyehang tsa modular.
Ho theha likhokahano tse emeng, tse ngotsoeng bakeng sa tšebelisano ea ka hare le ea balekane.

sec3List.bold: Khokahano ea data le ntlafatso ea database:
sec3List.text: Ho kopanya liphaephe tsa data tsa ts'ebetso tse nang le ts'ebeliso ea lipotso tse phahameng.
Ho kenya tshebetsong telemetry, ditsela tsa tlhatlhobo, le taolo ya phihlello e itshetlehileng hodima ditshebeletso tsohle.

businessTransformation.sec4P1: Metheo ea data e hokahaneng e fetola tsela eo boetapele le lihlopha tsa ts'ebetso li sebelisanang le tlhahisoleseling. Sebakeng sa ho ts'epa litlaleho tsa morao-rao tse bonts'ang se etsahetseng libekeng tse fetileng, mekhatlo e fumana telemetry ea ts'ebetso ho pholletsa le likarolo tsa khoebo.
businessTransformation.sec4P2: Lintlha tse hokahantsoeng le analytics li tšehetsa sephetho sa khoebo se tšoarellang ka:

sec4List.text: Ponaletso e tsoelang pele ho pholletsa le thekiso, thepa, phethahatso, le ts'ebetso ea lichelete.
Pokello ea data e batloang haholo e felisang li-spreadsheet tse iphetang.
Litlhaloso tse le 'ngoe tsa metrics joalo ka margin, boleng ba bophelo bohle ba moreki, le lebelo la pele.
Ho fumanwa ha paterone e lebelletseng e bontshang dikotsi le menyetla pele ho nako.
Ketso ea boits'epo ea bolaoli e ts'ehetsoeng ke lethathamo le netefalitsoeng la data le pepeneneng.

artificialIntelligence.sec1Eyebrow: HO FETOHA HO FIHLELA TLHOKOMELISO EA MATSOHO
artificialIntelligence.sec1Subtext: Bohlale ba Maiketsetso bo ntse bo fetoha ho tloha ho merero ea lehlakore ea liteko ho ea lits'ebetsong tsa mantlha tsa ts'ebetso tseo likhoebo li itšetlehileng ka tsona letsatsi le letsatsi.
artificialIntelligence.sec2Subtext: Ho fetela ka nģ'ane ho lingoloa tse thehiloeng ho melao ea setso ho ea ho ts'ebetso ea kelello e utloisisang litaba tse sa hlophisoang, e ikamahanyang le mefuta e fapaneng, le ho ntlafatsa lits'ebetso ka matla.
artificialIntelligence.sec3Subtext: E ipapisitse le tsebo ea mokhatlo le ts'ireletso ea likhoebo, bathusi ba AI ba sebetsa joalo ka balekane ba khethehileng ho pholletsa le ts'ebetso ea letsatsi le letsatsi ea khoebo.
artificialIntelligence.sec4Subtext: Ho fetola litlaleho tsa khoebo tsa nalane le liphepelo tsa tšebetso ea nako ea nnete hore e be ponelo-pele e sebetsang.
artificialIntelligence.sec5Heading: Maemo a Tšebeliso ea AI ea Khoebo
artificialIntelligence.sec5Subtext: Mekhoa e sebetsang e etellang mekhatlo pele e sebelisa bohlale ba maiketsetso mesebetsing ea mantlha ea khoebo.
artificialIntelligence.sec6Subtext: Ha e kengoa ts'ebetsong ka mokhoa o nahanoang ka lintlha tsa khoebo tse laoloang, AI e notlolla melemo e mengata ea boleng.
artificialIntelligence.ctaHeading: Hlahloba Menyetla ea AI bakeng sa Khoebo ea Hao
artificialIntelligence.ctaDescription: Fumana hore na othomathike o bohlale, bakopitsi ba likhoebo le mefuta e lebelloang esale pele li ka u thusa joang ho u thusa ho sebetsana ka katleho le litsamaiso tsa hau tsa mantlha.
artificialIntelligence.sec1P1: Ka lilemo tse ngata, bohlale ba maiketsetso ba khoebo bo ne bo nkoa e le bokhoni ba kantle: mohlala o koetliselitsoeng ho itšehla thajana, pontšo ea sandbox, kapa chatbot e ka thoko e fumanehang ka portal e arohaneng. Kajeno, paradigm e fetohile haholo. Khoebo e nang le tšusumetso e phahameng ea AI e kenyelelitsoe ka kotloloho ka har'a lits'ebetso tsa rekoto - li-ERP, li-CRM, li-platform tsa batho, le lienjineri tsa phepelo moo khoebo ea 'nete e etsahalang.
artificialIntelligence.sec1P2: Ha bohlale bo sebetsa ka har'a sistimi ea rekoto, bo rua meeli ea ts'ireletso e thehiloeng ke mokhatlo, mehlala ea data, le menahano ea khoebo. Ha e hlahise feela likarabo tse akaretsang; e sebetsa ho latela litaelo tse teng, e toloka litekete tse bulehileng tsa tšehetso, e hokahanya li-invoice tsa barekisi, 'me e thusa basebetsi ka har'a lihokelo tseo ba li tsamaisang letsatsi le letsatsi.
artificialIntelligence.sec1P3: Phetoho ena e tsamaisa software ea khoebo ho tsoa litsing tsa polokelo tse emelang likonopo tsa batho ho li etsa li-platform tse lebelletseng litlhoko, mehato e ikemetseng, le likhothaletso tse nakong.
artificialIntelligence.sec2P1: Traditional Robotic Process Automation (RPA) e ipabole ka mokhoa o hlakileng, o pheta-phetoang skrineng. Leha ho le joalo, melao e thata e beha khefu neng kapa neng ha foromo e fetoha, sebopeho sa tokomane se sa lebelloang se fihla, kapa ho hlaha mokhelo. Intelligent automation e kopanya karohano ena ka ho kopanya mabaka a kelello le ts'ebetso ea transaction:

sec2List.text: Ho hlophisa ts'ebetso e rarahaneng ea mafapha a fapaneng, ho tsamaisa mesebetsi e ipapisitseng le maemo a potlakileng le a nalane ea tharollo.
Ho kenya li-PDF tse sa hlophisoang, li-imeile, lipontšo tsa thomello, le likonteraka, ho li fetolela hore e be litšebelisano tse hlophisitsoeng tsa database.
Ho iketsetsa linetefatso tsa ts'ebetso ea mehato e mengata-joalo ka ho bapisa litaelo tsa theko khahlanong le lirisiti le litatemente tsa banka.
Ho tsoelapele ho sekaseka lits'ebetso ho tseba mathata a nako ea potoloho le ho khothaletsa ntlafatso ea phallo ea mosebetsi.

copilotCards.title: Patlo ea Boitsebiso
copilotCards.desc: Khutliso ea semantic ho pholletsa le metheo ea tsebo e ajoang, maano a intranet, litlhaloso tsa sehlahisoa, le liqeto tsa litekete tsa nalane ntle le ho hakanya mantsoe a bohlokoa.

copilotCards.title: Kakaretso ea Litokomane
copilotCards.desc: Distillation hang-hang tsa li-RFP tse telele, litumellano tsa barekisi, litlhaloso tsa tekheniki, le litokiso tsa molao hore li be likhuts'oane tsa tsamaiso le lethathamo la likotsi.

copilotCards.title: Moloko oa Litaba
copilotCards.desc: Ho thusoa ho ngola litlhahiso tsa bareki, litokomane tsa ts'ebetso, mekhoa e tloaelehileng ea ts'ebetso (SOPs), le lintlafatso tse tloaelehileng tsa bareki tse tsamaellanang le litekanyetso tsa brand.

copilotCards.title: Tlhahlobo ea Lintlha
copilotCards.desc: Ho fetolela lipotso tsa moqoqo hore e be lipotso tse thata tsa tlhahlobo, ho hlahisa likakaretso tsa lichate le ho totobatsa lintlha tsa bohlokoa tsa boetapele.

copilotCards.title: Tsamaiso ea Mosebetsi oa Khoebo
copilotCards.desc: Ho qala transaction ka kotloloho ho tsoa meqoqong ea moqoqo-joalo ka ho hlophisa lisebelisoa, ho etsa litekete, ho nchafatsa lirekoto, kapa ho fana ka litlhokahalo tsa theko.

copilotCards.title: Phihlello e nang le Karolo e Batlang Karolo
copilotCards.desc: Ho netefatsa dikarabo tsa mokopitsi ho hlompha ka thata maemo a tumello ya mosebedisi, ho boloka ditjhelete tsa lekunutu, difaele tsa HR, le thepa ya mahlale e sireleditsweng.

artificialIntelligence.sec4P1: Le hoja mefuta ea tlhahiso e ipabola tabeng ea ho utloisisa le ho kopanya puo, bohlale ba ho bolela esale pele bo tsepamisitse maikutlo holim'a mekhoa ea lipalo e patiloeng ka har'a pokello ea lintlha tsa likhoebo tse hlophisitsoeng. Mefuta e kenyellelitsoeng esale pele e matlafatsa mekhatlo ho lebella litšitiso tsa ts'ebetso pele li senya ts'ebetso:

sec4List.text: Ho bolela esale pele maemo a lekeno, lebelo la thepa, le litlhoko tsa lisebelisoa ka ho kopanya matšoao a linako tsa selemo ka lebelo la lipeipi tsa nako ea nnete.

sec4List.bold: Litlhahlobo tsa ho bolela esale pele:
sec4List.text: Ho supa likotsi tsa mosebelisi, linako tsa ho senyeha ha tlhokomelo, le tieho ea ketane ea phepelo ha nako e ntse e le teng ea ho kenella.
Ho tshwaya diphoso dikgwebong tsa ditjhelete, ho latela melao ya melao, le dipaterone tsa phumantsho ya barekisi pele di ka mpefala.
Ho tsamaisana le likhakanyo tsa thekiso le matla a tlhahiso le maemo a thepa ea polokelo ho sireletsa chelete e sebetsang.

artificialIntelligence.keyPerspectiveLead: AI e ka tšeptjoa feela joaloka motheo oa data ka tlas'a eona le puso e potolohileng eona. Ho amoheloa ka mokhoa o tsitsitseng oa khoebo ho hloka taeo ea meralo ea ka boomo:

modernErp.subtitle: Lekola hore na liforomo tsa sejoale-joale tsa ERP li hokahanya joang lichelete, theko, ketane ea phepelo le ts'ebetso ea khoebo ka metheo e kopaneng ea dijithale.

connectedFunctions.title: Tsamaiso ea Lichelete
connectedFunctions.desc: Lintlafatso tsa ledja tsa nako ea 'nete, temoho e itirisang ea lekeno, le poelano ea hang-hang ea lichelete tse ngata.

connectedFunctions.title: Phepelo le Tsamaiso
connectedFunctions.desc: Ponahalo ea thepa ea ho qetela ho isa qetellong, ntlafatso ea polokelo ea thepa, le telemetry ea tšebetso ea mofani oa thepa.

connectedFunctions.title: Bokhoni ba Batho le Basebetsi
connectedFunctions.desc: Li-portal tsa basebetsi ba itšebetsang, lits'ebetso tse ikemetseng tsa meputso, le moralo o kopaneng oa bophelo ba talenta.

connectedFunctions.title: Ho reka le ho fumana
connectedFunctions.desc: Ditumello tsa ho reka ka boiketsetso, ho latela melao ya konteraka ya barekisi, le ditlhahlobo tse matla tsa tshenyehelo.

modernCapabilities.title: Cloud-Native Architecture
modernCapabilities.desc: Elastic compute scaling ntle le meralo ea motheo e holim'a meaho kapa mofuta o sitisang oa ho notlela.

modernCapabilities.title: Bula API Ecosystem
modernCapabilities.desc: Lihokelo tse hahiloeng esale pele tse nolofalletsang khokahanyo ea data ea mekhoa e 'meli e sa sebetseng le li-microservices tsa tloaelo le lisutu tsa CRM.

modernCapabilities.title: Embedded Analytics
modernCapabilities.desc: Litlhahiso tse tobileng tsa dashboard ho tloha ho li-balance sheets tsa boemo bo holimo ho ea ho li-log tsa transaction.

modernCapabilities.title: Lisebelisoa tse Ikemetseng tsa Phallo ea Mosebetsi
modernCapabilities.desc: Ketsahalo e tsamaiswang ke ketsahalo e etsa hore ho be le tshebetso e tlwaelehileng ya mafapha ka boikemelo.

erpBusinessBenefits: Mohloli o le mong oa 'nete o felisang litlaleho tse hanyetsanang tsa lefapha
Phokotso e matla ea linako tsa ho qetela tsa khoeli le kotara
Setoko sa nako ea sebele le ponahalo ea thepa e fokotsang ho tsoa ha stock
E fokotsitse tlhokomelo ea IT ka holimo ka lintlafatso tsa modular cloud-native
Ho latela melao e kopanetsweng ho phatlalla le ditikoloho tse ngata tsa lekgetho
Ho kena ka potlako ha mekhatlo e rekiloeng ho ba mokokotlo oa ts'ebetso o arolelanoang
erpStrategyPoints: Ho hokahanya meralo ea ERP le ts'ebetso ea mantlha ea ts'ebetso pele ho tlhophiso
Ho khetha mekhoa ea ho tsamaisa modular ho fumana katleho e potlakileng
Ho etelletsa pele phalliso ea data ea boleng bo holimo le poelano
Ho kenyeletswa taolong ya phetoho e itirisang le mananeo a dithupelo a ikamahanyang le maemo
Ho rala liheke tsa API bakeng sa katoloso e se nang likhohlano ea kopano ea nako e tlang
modernErp.sec1Heading: Ke Hobane'ng ha ERP ea Kajeno e le Bohlokoa
modernErp.sec1Subtext: ERP ha e sa le accounting ea ofising feela. Ke mohlala oa ts'ebetso oa khoebo ea sejoale-joale e hlahisitsoeng ho software.
modernErp.sec2Subtext: Boleng ba 'nete ba mokhatlo bo hlahella ha mesebetsi ea mantlha ea khoebo e sebelisana hammoho motheong o arolelanoang oa dijithale.
modernErp.sec3Heading: Ts'ebetso e Kopantsoeng le Phallo ea Litaba
modernErp.sec3Subtext: Ho heletsa marako a puisano lipakeng tsa mafapha ho etsa hore khoebo e sebetse hantle.
modernErp.sec4Heading: Ponahalo ea Khoebo ea Nako ea Sebele
modernErp.sec4Subtext: Ho kopanya metrics ea ts'ebetso ho li-dashboards tse pepeneneng tse bonts'ang linnete tsa hajoale tsa khoebo.
modernErp.sec5Subtext: Litšobotsi tsa meralo tse arohanyang lipolanete tsa mehleng ena tsa ERP ho tse kentsoeng ka thata tsa lefa.
modernErp.sec6Subtext: Ho hokahanya lits'ebetso tsa mantlha tsa khoebo motheong o kopaneng oa dijithale ho fana ka botsitso bo lekantsoeng ba mokhatlo.
modernErp.ctaHeading: Fetola Lits'ebetso tsa Hao tsa Khoebo
modernErp.ctaDescription: Lekola hore na liforomo tsa sejoale-joale tsa ERP li hokahanya joang lichelete, theko, ketane ea phepelo le ts'ebetso ea khoebo ka metheo e kopaneng ea dijithale.
modernErp.sec1P1: Libakeng tsa likhoebo tse tsamaeang ka potlako, mekhoa ea khale ea Enterprise Resource Planning hangata e thatafalloa. E hahiloe nakong ea ts'ebetso ea li-batch le li-server tse ikhethileng tsa lehae, li-ERP tsa lefa li ne li hlophisitsoe ka mokhoa o ikhethileng, ho le thata ho li ntlafatsa, 'me habohloko li sa bonahale. Ts'ebetso ea bohlokoa ea khoebo e sebetsa ka har'a li-siloes tse tšoanang, tse itšetlehileng ka thepa e tsoang kantle ho naha ka bosiu bo le bong ho hokahanya lireche le matlo a polokelo.
modernErp.sec1P2: ERP ea sejoale-joale, e fumanehang marung e hlalosa sena bocha. E sebetsa e le mokokotlo o kopaneng oa dijithale oa khoebo - motheo o phelang moo lichelete, theko, ketane ea phepelo, thepa le lisebelisoa tsa batho li sebetsanang le mofuta oa data o arolelanoeng.
modernErp.sec1P3: Ka ho tlisa ts'ebetso ea mantlha tikolohong e le 'ngoe e lumellanang, ERP ea sejoale-joale e felisa libaka tse foufetseng tsa ts'ebetso tse liehisang kholo, e leng se nolofalletsang baetapele ho tsamaisa khoebo ka ho sebelisa lipontšo tsa nako ea sebele ho e-na le likakaretso tsa khale tsa histori.
modernErp.sec3P1: Li-silo tse sebetsang hangata ke mathata a batho; ke mathata a meralo. Ha lihlopha tsa litšebeletso tsa bareki, thepa le thepa ea polokelo li sebetsa lits'ebetsong tse khaotsoeng, letsoho le leng le le leng le hloka mangolo-tsoibila, li-spreadsheet le mehala. Liphoso lia ata, li-invoice lia bolokoa, 'me boitlamo ba bareki boa fokotseha.
modernErp.sec3P2: ERP ea sejoale-joale e sebetsana le sena ka lethathamo le kopaneng la data le 'mino o tsamaisoang ke ketsahalo:

sec3List.text: Ha odara ea bareki e behiloe, lethathamo la thepa le ipolokela, li-label tsa thomello li hlahisa, 'me libuka tsa litefiso li ntlafatsoa hang-hang.
Liodara tsa theko, lirisiti tsa thepa, le li-invoice tsa barekisi li ipapisa le poelano ea mekhoa e 3, e tšoaeang mekhelo feela bakeng sa tlhahlobo ea batho.

sec3List.bold: Litšenyehelo tse kopaneng tsa basebetsi le ts'ebetso:
sec3List.text: Lipampiri tsa linako tsa projeke, likabelo tsa meputso, le 'mapa o tobileng oa lits'enyehelo tsa ts'ebetso ho litsi tsa litšenyehelo ka nako ea nnete.

modernErp.sec4P1: Ho tsamaisa khoebo ntle le ponahalo e kopaneng ho tšoana le ho fofa ka har'a moholi o teteaneng ka lisebelisoa tse liehang. ERP ea sejoale-joale e fana ka telemetry ea nako ea nnete maemong ohle a khoebo:

sec4List.text: Maikutlo a hang-hang a likhahla tse felletseng, phallo ea chelete ea ts'ebetso, melato e bulehileng, le lits'oants'o tse saletseng morao ntle le ho emela ho koaloa ha nako.
Baetapele ba mafapha ba ka theha lipotso tsa tloaelo le ho theola kakaretso ea boemo ba khoebo ho ea ho lintlha tsa khoebo ka bomong.
Ho felisa lipalo tse hanyetsanang ka ho theha data e laoloang e le 'ngoe bakeng sa bareki, barekisi, le lethathamo la lihlahisoa.

sec4List.bold: Tlhokomeliso e tsoelang pele e sa tsitsang:
sec4List.text: Ditemoso tse itirisang di tsebisa batsamaisi hang hang ha mekgabiso e theohile ka tlase ho moedi, lethathamo la thepa le theoha, kapa ho thella ha thepa ya ho romela thepa.

modernErp.keyPerspectiveLead: Phetoho ea sejoale-joale ea ERP e ea atleha ha mekhatlo e e nka e le ntlafatso ea ts'ebetso ho e-na le tšitiso ea IT kaofela kapa e se nang letho:

incidentReadinessPhases.desc: Ho kenngoa ha log ka nako ea sebele le khokahanyo e sa tloaelehang ea SIEM ho pholletsa le libaka tsohle tsa maru le mesebetsi e mengata.

incidentReadinessPhases.title: Tšireletso le ho itšehla thajana
incidentReadinessPhases.desc: Melao ea karabelo ea marang-rang e khethollang lijana kapa mangolo a netefalitsoeng hang hang.

incidentReadinessPhases.title: Tokiso & Motso-Sesosa
incidentReadinessPhases.desc: Phatlalatso e potlakileng le diforensiki tsa dijithale tse hlwayang vector e robehileng.

incidentReadinessPhases.title: Ho mamella le ho thatafala
incidentReadinessPhases.desc: Maikutlo a sa khaotseng mabapi le li-backups tse sa fetoheng, litebello tsa maano, le lipapiso tse itirisang tsa lihlopha tse khubelu.

cyberBusinessBenefits: Phokotso e kholo ea litlhaselo tsa ts'oaetso ho pholletsa le thepa ea maru
Ts'ebetso e tiisitsoeng ea ts'ebetso le ho hlaphoheloa ha likoluoa ka RTO/RPO e fokolang
Kholiseho e felletseng ea boitlamo ho pholletsa le liphuputso tsa ISO 27001, SOC 2, HIPAA, le GDPR
Tšireletso ea thepa ea bohlale ea mantlha ea khoebo le lirekoto tsa lekunutu tsa bareki
E tsamaellana le taolo ea kotsi ea barekisi le motho oa boraro ka taolo e kopaneng ea phihlello
Ts'epo e ntlafalitsoeng ea bareki le batseteli e tšehelitsoe ke maemo a netefalitsoeng a ts'ireletso ea zero-trust
zeroTrustPrinciples: Le ka mohla U se Ke Ua Tšepa, Netefatsa Kamehla: Ho hlokahala netefatso e hlakileng bakeng sa khoebo e ngoe le e ngoe
Phihlello-Haholo-holo: Meeli ea karolo e fokolang e fokotsang motsamao oa litšokelo
Nahana ka Tlōlo: Tlhokomelo e sa khaotseng ea litšokelo, ho patala ha lipalangoang le ho phomola
Micro-Segmentation: Li-firewall tsa marang-rang tse arolang mesebetsi ea motho ka mong

cybersecurity.sec1Subtext: Ha mekhatlo ea sejoale-joale e hokahanya lits'ebetso tse ngata, tikoloho ea maru, basebetsi ba hole, lisebelisoa tsa mehala, le balekane ba motho oa boraro, pherimitha ea ts'ireletso ea setso ha e sa le teng.
cybersecurity.sec2Subtext: Tšireletso e sebetsang e sireletsang litšebeletso tsa motheo, lintlha tsa bohlokoa tsa mekhatlo, le mekhoa ea ts'ebetso.
cybersecurity.sec3Subtext: Identity ke motheo oa taolo ea sefofane sa ts'ireletso ea sejoale-joale. Hoo e ka bang litlolo tsohle tse tebileng tsa ts'ireletso li qala ka lintlha tse sekiselitsoeng ho fapana le ts'ebeliso ea software.
cybersecurity.sec4Subtext: Zero Trust ha se sehlahisoa kapa sesebelisoa se le seng. Ke leano la meralo le ipapisitseng le molao-motheo o otlolohileng: ho se tšepe mokhatlo kahare kapa kantle ho marang-rang ka boiketsetso.
cybersecurity.sec5Subtext: Ho sireletsa mesebetsi ho pholletsa le maru a sechaba, meaho e nyalisitsoeng, le tikoloho ea lijana tse ajoang.
cybersecurity.sec6Heading: Boikemisetso ba Ketsahalo: Ho Feta Thibelo
cybersecurity.sec6Subtext: Boiketlo ba 'nete ba marang-rang bo amohela hore liketsahalo li ka etsahala. Boitokisetso bo shebana le ho boloka chelete ka potlako, tšitiso e fokolang ea khoebo, le ho hlaphoheloa ho netefalitsoeng.
cybersecurity.sec7Subtext: Ho aha khoebo e sebetsanang le khomphutha ho sireletsa boleng ba mokhatlo, boemo ba taolo, le seriti sa mmaraka.
cybersecurity.ctaHeading: Matlafatsa Ts'ireletso ea Khoebo ea Hau
cybersecurity.ctaDescription: Lekola ka moo mekhatlo e ka matlafatsang ts'ireletso, ho sireletsa lits'ebetso tsa bohlokoa le ho itokisetsa litšokelo ho pholletsa le libaka tse ntseng li eketseha tse hokahaneng.
cybersecurity.sec1P1: Mehleng ea lefa la khoebo ea IT, ts'ireletso e ne e sebetsa ka thuto ea castle-and-moat: ntho e 'ngoe le e 'ngoe ka har'a marang-rang a liofisi tsa khoebo e ne e nkoa e le ea ts'eptjoang, athe ntho e 'ngoe le e' ngoe e ka ntle e ne e nkoa e sa tšepahale. Firewall e le 'ngoe e sirelelitseng li-server tsa ka hare, li-database, le lik'homphieutha tsa desktop.
cybersecurity.sec1P2: Khoebo ea kajeno e tsoile marako a 'mele. Mesebetsi e mengata e lula libakeng tse nang le maru a mangata (AWS, Azure, GCP), basebetsi ba fihlella lits'ebetso tsa khoebo ho tsoa libakeng tse fapaneng, 'me li-API li lula li fapanyetsana lintlha tsa ts'ebetso le bafani ba thepa ea kantle, litsi tsa lichelete le barekisi ba SaaS.
cybersecurity.sec1P3: Leha khokahano ena ea hyper-connection e ntse e etsa hore khoebo e be mahlahahlaha, e holisa haholo sebaka sa tlhaselo ea khoebo. Sebaka se seng le se seng sa API, tokene ea boitsebiso, sesebelisoa sa mohala se hokahaneng, le khokahano ea SaaS e emela vector e ka bang teng ea ho pepeseha. Ts'ireletso ea 'nete ea khoebo e hloka ho tloha ho ts'ireletso e thehiloeng ho pota-potileng ho ea ho ts'ireletso e matla, ho isa qetellong ea cyber.

sec2Cards.title: Ho Fumana Tšokelo
sec2Cards.desc: Mahlale a ts'okelo a ho ithuta ka mochini a hlokomelang mekhoa e sa tloaelehang ea marang-rang, tlhekefetso ea litokomane, le bofokoli ba matsatsi a se nang letho ka nako ea nnete.

sec2Cards.title: Tlhokomelo ya Tshireletso
sec2Cards.desc: Centralized Security Operations Center (SOC) telemetry e hokahanyang liketsahalo ho pholletsa le li-server, lihlopha tsa lijana, bafani ba boitsebiso, le li-endpoints.

sec2Cards.title: Taolo ea Kotsi
sec2Cards.desc: Ho hlahlobisisa ts'oenyeho ea ts'okelo e tsoelang pele ho pholletsa le meaho, polokelo ea likhoutu tsa mohloli, le liregistries tsa lijana ho lokisa mefokolo ka potlako.

sec2Cards.title: Tšireletso ea Boitsebiso
sec2Cards.desc: Robust encryption in transit (TLS 1.3) le phomolong (AES-256), hammoho le granular data loss prevention (DLP) puso ho thibela ho lutla ha thepa ea mahlale.

cybersecurity.sec3P1: Ho sireletsa thepa ya kgwebo ho hloka ho netefatswa hore boitsebiso bo bong le bo bong—ebang ke molaodi wa batho, rakonteraka wa kantle, kapa akhaonto e ikemetseng ya tshebeletso ya software—e netefaditse tumello bakeng sa disebediswa tseo e di fihlelang.

sec3List.text: Sing-On (SSO) le litekanyetso tse kopanetsoeng tsa boitsebiso tse felisang mabenkele a arohaneng a li-password ho pholletsa le lits'ebetso.

sec3List.bold: Netefatso e feto-fetohang ea lintho tse ngata (MFA):
sec3List.text: Linotlolo tsa FIDO2 tse thibelang phishing le liphephetso tse ipapisitseng le kotsi bakeng sa mesebetsi e hlokolosi ea tsamaiso.
Fine-grained Role-Based (RBAC) le Attribute-based (ABAC) taolo ea phihlello e kentsoeng tšebetsong ho API le maemong a database.
Ho fana ka phihlello ea nakoana, ka nako feela (JIT) e felloang ke nako ka bo eona ha mesebetsi ea tsamaiso e phetheloa.

cybersecurity.keyPerspectiveTitle: Netefatso e Tsoelang Pele ho Feta Blind Trust
cybersecurity.keyPerspectiveLead: Moahong oa Zero Trust, tšepo e felletseng e ipapisitseng le sebaka sa marang-rang e felisitsoe ka botlalo. Ts'ebetso e 'ngoe le e' ngoe, potso ea database, le ho kena ha basebelisi li tlameha ho tsoela pele ho paka bonnete ba eona:

cloudSecurityCards.title: Boikarabello bo Abelaneng
cloudSecurityCards.desc: Tsamaiso e hlakileng e khethollang ts'ireletso ea mantlha ea mofani oa maru ho boikarabello ba k'hamphani bakeng sa encryption ea data, melaoana ea IAM, le khoutu ea ts'ebeliso.

cloudSecurityCards.title: Infrastructure as Code (IaC)
cloudSecurityCards.desc: Litlhophiso tsa maru tse sa fetoheng, tse lekoang tse laoloang ka khoutu. Li-scanner tse itirisang tsa leano-joalo ka khoutu li thibela ho se sebetse hantle le libakete tse pepesitsoeng pele li romelloa.

cloudSecurityCards.title: Setshelo & Tšireletso ea Kubernetes
cloudSecurityCards.desc: Linako tsa ho sebetsa tsa lijana tse thatafalitsoeng, liregistries tsa litšoantšo tse saenneng, likaroloana tse nyane tsa marang-rang, le taolo ea lekunutu e ikemetseng e bolokang mangolo a bopaki a le sieo mehloling ea polokelo.

cloudModernization.title: Ho Nchafatsa Likopo tsa Lefa bakeng sa Cloud
cloudModernization.subtitle: Lekola mokhoa o sebetsang oa ho lekola, ho nchafatsa le ho tsamaisa lits'ebetso tsa lefa mabapi le meaho e sireletsehileng ea maru.
cloudModernization.imageCaption: Tebello ea Theknoloji ea Khoebo - Cloud-Native Re-platforming & Containerization

modernizationApproaches.title: Rehost (Phahamisa & Shift)
modernizationApproaches.desc: Fetolela meroalo ea mosebetsi ho koala mechini e sebetsang kapele ka liphetoho tse nyane tsa khoutu.

modernizationApproaches.title: Replatform (Phahamisa & Shape)
modernizationApproaches.desc: Ntlafatsa meralo ea nako ea ho sebetsa, sebelisa li-database tse laoloang tsa maru, le ho tsamaisa tšebetso.

modernizationApproaches.title: Refactor (Cloud-Native Rebuild)
modernizationApproaches.desc: Hlakola li-monoliths ka har'a li-microservices tse kentsoeng ka har'a litšepe le li-API tse tsamaisoang ke ketsahalo.

modernizationApproaches.title: Fetola (SaaS Modernization)
modernizationApproaches.desc: Tlosa lits'ebetso tse sa sebetseng tsa lefa molemong oa software ea khoebo e hahelletsoeng ka morero.

cloudArchitectureFlow.title: Tekolo ea Lefa
cloudArchitectureFlow.desc: 'Mapa o itšebetsang oa ho its'etleha, lethathamo la mekoloto ea tekheniki, le lintlha tsa ho ipapisa le maru.

cloudArchitectureFlow.title: Morero oa Architecture
cloudArchitectureFlow.desc: Meralo e menyenyane ea litšebeletso tse nyenyane, lihlooho tsa lihlooho tsa setshelo, le lithempleite tsa IaC tse iketsetsang.

cloudArchitectureFlow.title: Phalliso ea Mokhahlelo
cloudArchitectureFlow.desc: Lits'oants'o tsa Canary, khokahano ea data e ngotsoeng habeli, le maqhubu a khaotsoeng a zero-downtime.

cloudArchitectureFlow.title: Ntlafatso ea Leru
cloudArchitectureFlow.desc: Puso ea litšenyehelo e tsoelang pele, telemetry ea autoscaling, le litlhahlobo tsa ts'ebetso ea FinOps.

cloudModernizationBenefits: Litšenyehelo tsa tlhokomelo ea litšebeletso tsa motheo tse tlase haholo le litšenyehelo tsa ho nchafatsa thepa
Haufi le ho sa feleng compute elasticity ho sebetsana le sephethephethe se phahameng sa khoebo se nang le zero latency
Lebelo le potlakileng la tokollo ka liphaephe tsa phepelo ea CI/CD
Ho felisoa ha lintlha tsa lefa tse sa atleheng ka ho fumaneha ha li-AZ tse ngata
Meetso ea sejoale-joale ea API e nolofalletsang likhokahano tse potlakileng tsa balekane
Ponahalo e tsoetseng pele ea nako ea nnete ts'ebetsong ea ts'ebeliso le tšebelisong ea maru
landscapeAssessmentPoints: Ho etsa 'mapa litšepeho tse rarahaneng tsa har'a likopo le likhokahano tsa data
Ho hloaea tlhophiso ea tikoloho e thatafalitsoeng le meralo ea polokelo ea thepa
Ho lekola boikamahanyo ba taolo le lithibelo tsa bobusi ba data sebakeng se seng le se seng
Ho baloa Litšenyehelo Kakaretso tsa Botho (TCO) ho pholletsa le refactor khahlano le litsela tsa rehost
Ho theha maqhubu a hlakileng a phallo ho sireletsa ts'ebetso ea khoebo ea letsatsi le letsatsi
cloudModernization.sec1Subtext: Li-monoliths tsa botsofali li thibela lebelo la boqapi, li eketsa bofokoli ba ts'ebetso, 'me li eketsa litšenyehelo tsa tokiso ea litšebeletso.
cloudModernization.sec2Subtext: Katleho ea ntlafatso ea maru e qala ka tlhahlobo e matla. Ho tlolela ka kotloloho ho falla ntle le ho itšetleha ka likopo tsa tlhahlobo ke sesosa se ka sehloohong sa tieho ea li-cutovers.
cloudModernization.sec3Subtext: Ha ho na leano le lekanang le le leng la ho falla. Likhoebo tse etelletseng pele li tsamaisana le mokhoa o nepahetseng oa sejoale-joale bakeng sa mosebetsi o mong le o mong o ipapisitseng le boleng ba khoebo, ho potlaka le mokoloto oa tekheniki.
cloudModernization.sec4Subtext: 'Mapa o hlophisitsoeng o fetolang li-monoliths tsa lefa hore e be lits'ebeletso tse otlolohileng, tse bolokehileng le tse tšoarellang tsa maru.
cloudModernization.sec5Subtext: Ho tsamaisa litsamaiso tsa lefa holim'a meralo ea sejoale-joale ea maru ho fana ka bokhabane bo hlakileng ba ts'ebetso le ho tsebahatsa litšenyehelo esale pele.
cloudModernization.ctaHeading: Nchafatsa Likopo tsa Lefa la Hao
cloudModernization.ctaDescription: Lekola mokhoa o sebetsang oa ho lekola, ho nchafatsa le ho tsamaisa lits'ebetso tsa lefa mabapi le meaho e sireletsehileng ea maru.
cloudModernization.sec1P1: Lisebelisoa tsa bohlokoahali tse hahiloeng lilemong tse leshome tse fetileng li ntse li kenya libilione ho lekeno la likhoebo, empa ho se tsitse ha meralo ea bona ho baka kotsi e ntseng e eketseha ea ts'ebetso.
cloudModernization.sec1P2: Khamphani e 'ngoe le e 'ngoe e tobane le tsitsipano lipakeng tsa botsitso le sejoale-joale. Litsamaiso tsa lefa li entsoe hore li tšoarelle nako e telele, 'me li sebelitse ka botšepehi ka lilemo tse ngata. Leha ho le joalo, ha litlhoko tsa khoebo li ntse li potlakisa, meralo ena ea botsofali e kopana le meeli ea sebopeho:

sec1List.text: Monolithic codebases e hahiloeng holim'a meralo e sa sebetseng e nang le matamo a fokolang a talenta a fumanehang bakeng sa tlhokomelo.
Likarolo tse kopantsoeng ka thata-thata moo ho fetola tšobotsi e le 'ngoe ho ka bang kotsi ho senya li-module tsa ts'ebetso tse sa amaneng.
Meeli e otlolohileng e hlokang ho reka thepa ea thepa e turang ho sebetsana le ho phahama ha sephethephethe sa sehla.
Ho se khone ho hokahana hantle le lits'ebetso tsa sejoale-joale tsa mehala, li-portal tsa bareki, kapa li-API tsa balekane ntle le mengolo ea batch e senyehang.
Lipolelo tsa bophelo tsa kamore ea seva, bofokoli ba ho boloka, le litšenyehelo tse phahameng tsa ts'ebetso ea matla / pholileng.

cloudModernization.sec2P1: Leeto la pragmatic la ntlafatso ea sejoale-joale le qala ka ho fana ka lintlha tse hlakileng ho pholletsa le thepa e teng:

sec2List.text: Ho hlophisa mesebetsi eohle e sebetsang, li-module tsa tloaelo, lingoloa tsa morao-rao, le liphutheloana tsa nalane tsa mokha oa boraro.
Ho etsa 'mapa o rarahaneng oa ho kopanya nako ea ho sebetsa, litafole tsa database tse arolelanoang, mehala e tobileng ea sistimi ea faele, le likonteraka tsa litšebeletso tsa kantle.
Ho lekola libopeho tsa data, litlhoko tsa bots'epehi ba transactional, backup cadence, le melaoana ea taolo ea bobusi.
Ho hlahloba CPU, memori, ts'ebeliso ea polokelo, le ts'ebetso ea marang-rang ho latela litlhaloso tsa maru tse lekantsoeng.
Ho arola lits'ebetso ka mekhahlelo ho rala maqhubu a falla a bolokehileng, a hlophisitsoeng ka mokhoa o hlakileng oa ho khutlela morao.

cloudModernization.cloudArchitectureTitle: Qetello-ho-Qetellong Phallo ea Moralo oa Leru
cloudModernization.sec4P1: Moaho oa meralo o arola lits'ebetso tsa mantlha hore e be lits'ebeletso tsa modular, tse nang le setshelo tse tsamaisoang ka sethala sa maru se otlolohileng (joalo ka Kubernetes kapa linako tse tsamaisoang tse se nang seva).
cloudModernization.sec4P2: Ka ho theha liphaephe tsa ho tsamaisa tsa CI/CD tse itšebetsang, li-cutovers tse iketsang tse botala bo boputsoa, ​​​​le meaho e le khoutu, lipehelo li fetoha ho tloha liketsahalong tsa mafelo-beke tse senyang methapo ho ba lits'ebetso tsa letsatsi le letsatsi tse se nang moeli.
cloudModernization.sec4P3: Khomphutha e hlabollang e ikemela ka bo eona nakong ea ho phahama ha tlhokahalo le sekala nakong ea ho thella, e felisa litšenyehelo tsa lisebelisoa tse sa sebetseng ha e ntse e netefatsa nako ea karabelo ea motsotsoana bakeng sa basebelisi ba lefats'e.
cloudModernization.keyPerspectiveTitle: Litšiea tse ’nè tsa Phallo e Atlehileng
cloudModernization.keyPerspectiveLead: Boiphihlelo bo bonts'a hore merero ea sejoale-joale e atleha ha e thehiloe holim'a boitokiso bo felletseng, tatellano e hlakileng ea maqhubu, le liteko tse matla:
